sources.entry: WWDC.srt - Powerful app for downloading subtitle for each WWDC session video since 2013 in (srt) format.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app that downloads subtitle files (SRT format) for WWDC session videos from 2013 onward, and can also fetch video, PDF, and sample code links.
summary.what_it_does: WWDC.srt downloads subtitles for WWDC session videos since 2013 in SRT format. The Session tab lets you pick a session from a list or search by session number, then download its subtitle or data links, and an "All Sessions" option processes every session at once. Data links cover video (HD or SD, based on your choice), PDF, and sample code links. The Video Link tab takes a pasted WWDC video URL and downloads its subtitle. The Text File tab accepts a text file containing many WWDC video links, dragged into the view, and downloads their subtitles together. Release notes say later versions added support for WWDC 2016 through 2024 and Tech Talks video links, and that downloads open the destination folder in Finder when finished.
use_cases: get SRT captions for WWDC videos
batch download subtitles from a list of video links
collect WWDC video, PDF, and sample code links
how_to_run: Clone the branch containing the project.
Open the project in Xcode 9 or later.
stack: macOS app (Objective-C/Swift not specified in README)
notable: Covers WWDC sessions from 2013 through 2024 per the release notes
Can batch-download subtitles for all sessions at once
Drag-and-drop text file of video links for bulk processing
Also retrieves video (HD or SD), PDF, and sample code links
caveats: Building from source requires Xcode 9 or later
Only the README's listed WWDC years are documented; newer years may need updates
